$description: IQ Capital CRM design tokens. Source: Figma variables (file 6gc2fkxSUQG7VaiOSUz30L). Edit here, then run `npm run tokens` to regenerate tokens.css and the registry.

groups.name: Surface
groups.description: Backgrounds, from the page canvas up through raised panels and interaction fills.

groups.name: Content
groups.description: Text colors. Default for primary text, muted for secondary, disabled for unavailable controls.

groups.name: Icon
groups.description: Icon colors.

groups.name: Border
groups.description: Strokes and dividers.

groups.name: Status
groups.description: Brand accent and feedback colors.

groups.name: Overlay
groups.description: Scrims behind modals and drawers.

groups.name: Focus
groups.description: Keyboard focus ring. Applied as a 0-blur spread shadow so it never shifts layout.

groups.name: Typography
groups.description: Geist. Font size and line height pairs (line height is 150%). Full type styles are on the Typography page.

groups.name: Space
groups.description: Semantic spacing: gaps inside controls, horizontal insets, and vertical stacks.

groups.name: Radius
groups.description: Corner radius by role.

groups.name: Primitive colors
groups.description: The raw palette. Semantic and component tokens point here; components should not use these directly.

groups.name: Primitive space
groups.description: The spacing scale in px.

groups.name: Primitive radius
groups.description: The radius scale in px.

groups.name: Page Grid
groups.description: Content widths inside the app column (1616px at 1920). Widths are maximums: they shrink on smaller screens.

groups.name: Button / Layout
groups.description: Shape, spacing and size scale shared by Button and Button / Icon Only.

groups.name: Button / Content
groups.description: Label and icon colors.

groups.name: Button / Primary
groups.description: Brand green fill.

groups.name: Button / Secondary & Ghost
groups.description: Translucent white surfaces over the canvas.

groups.name: Button / Danger
groups.description: Destructive actions, filled and outline.

groups.name: Label Block
groups.description: Label and optional description above a control.

groups.name: Breadcrumb
groups.description: Trail links, current page, separators and the overflow trigger.

groups.name: Option Panel
groups.description: Floating option lists (used by the Breadcrumb overflow menu). Figma uses raw values here; named in code so they can be bound later.

groups.name: Combobox
groups.description: Select and Autocomplete: label, trigger (Figma Trigger) and Option Panel. The trigger reuses the Secondary button surface tokens.

groups.name: Trigger
groups.description: Dropdown trigger. Reuses the Secondary button surface; Large adds 48px.

groups.name: Search Bar
groups.description: Search field with optional scope dropdown and clear button.

groups.name: Selection Bar
groups.description: Bar shown while rows are selected: count, actions, clear.

groups.name: Dropdown
groups.description: Trigger + Option Panel at a fixed width, aligned left or right.

groups.name: Badge
groups.description: Badge primitive: 3 styles × 7 colors × 3 sizes, plus Badge / Delta.

groups.name: Stat Card
groups.description: KPI card text and layout. Figma binds the text to checkbox label variables; renamed here to what they mean.

groups.name: Chart
groups.description: Chart colors, axes, tooltip and card. Series 1–8 are Figma variables; the rest are raw values in Figma.

groups.name: Status Dot
groups.description: Semantic dot + label (used by the Split legend).

groups.name: Partner Logo
groups.description: Integration partner lockups: mark + name.

groups.name: Pill
groups.description: Removable value chip. Colors reuse the badge-* tokens (Figma’s color/* collection has identical values).

groups.name: Value Slot
groups.description: Table cell content.

groups.name: Checkbox
groups.description: Checkbox control and its 40px clickable row.

tokens.name: checkbox-fill-selected-hover
tokens.figma: Checkbox/fill/selected-hover (in Figma, no longer used by Checkbox or Radio)

tokens.name: checkbox-fill-selected-pressed
tokens.figma: Checkbox/fill/selected-pressed (in Figma, no longer used by Checkbox or Radio)

tokens.name: checkbox-fill-selected-disabled
tokens.figma: Checkbox/fill/selected-disabled (in Figma, no longer used by Checkbox or Radio)

groups.name: Table
groups.description: Data table cells, header, rows and status body.

groups.name: Pagination
groups.description: Table footer: page size, range and page controls.

groups.name: Input
groups.description: Single-line text input (Figma Input). Small 32px, Medium 40px.

groups.name: Form Field
groups.description: Stacked field: caption label inside the control, value row, helper below.

groups.name: Toast
groups.description: Transient feedback. All values are Figma toast-* variables.

groups.name: Tooltip
groups.description: White bubble with a caret. Placement Top, Bottom, Left, Right.

groups.name: Tabs
groups.description: Tabs / Pill: a track of pill items. Used for the chart range.

groups.name: Tabs / Line
groups.description: Underline tabs with tones.

groups.name: Calendar
groups.description: Date Picker calendar. All values are Figma calendar-* variables.

groups.name: Skeleton
groups.description: Loading placeholders. Pulse animates the bone between the two fills.
